# Asset72
> AI-powered real estate portfolio intelligence platform by Golden Hills. Analyzes T12s, rent rolls, NOI, occupancy, and market signals for institutional investors.

## Products
- Deal Lens: pre-underwriting deal screening
- Portfolio Intelligence: portfolio-wide risk & allocation
- AI Rent Intelligence: rent-roll pricing analysis
- Market Radar: competitive market signals
